name: The University of Texas at Arlington

ipeds.title: IPEDS College Navigator - The University of Texas at Arlington (admissions fall 2024, test scores, expenses)

stats.notes: Baseline from IPEDS College Navigator (fall 2024 entering class); no Common Data Set could be found on uta.edu. Navigator gives 24,623 applicants and 80% admitted (79% of men, 81% of women) but no admitted or enrolled counts, so those are left null; 26% of admitted students enrolled. SAT scores were submitted by 3,638 enrolled first-timers (70%) and ACT by 599 (12%). SAT total, GPA, residency and international splits come from the CDS and are not added.

cost.notes: IPEDS College Navigator 2024-25 first-time undergraduate expenses: tuition amounts include required fees; on-campus food and housing $11,228. Newer 2026-27 charges are on UTA's Student Accounts tuition charts and were not read.
